The strongest direct exposure is Amkor as a packaging-and-test platform; the cleaner underfollowed chokepoint candidates are FormFactor for HBM/advanced-packaging probe cards, Kulicke & Soffa for advanced-packaging assembly equipment, and Cohu for HBM inspection/metrology and semiconductor test automation. This is a research universe only, not a trading recommendation. Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around the backend capacity chokepoint. The strongest US-listed candidates are not AI chip designers but OSAT, probe-card, test-handler, inspection, metrology, and plating/chemistry suppliers that may benefit if HBM and advanced logic consume internal packaging/test capacity at IDMs and foundries. The list intentionally keeps NVIDIA, AMD, Broadcom, and TSMC out of the candidate set except as demand anchors, because the search focus is scarce suppliers and second-order backend beneficiaries.
